data.name: Std.LapsedNotice
data.value: The LMS add-on has lapsed: everything stays visible and lessons already assigned keep playing, but packages, tools and xAPI settings cannot be changed.

data.name: Std.AddonNotice
data.value: Content standards are part of the LMS add-on. Activate it to upload packages, register LTI tools and send xAPI statements.

data.name: Std.PackagesIntro
data.value: SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004 and cmi5 packages for course lessons, played in a sandboxed player.

data.name: Std.StoreNotConfigured
data.value: LMS media storage is not configured on this system, so packages cannot be uploaded or played.

data.name: Std.UploadHelp
data.value: Up to {0} MB. The zip must have imsmanifest.xml (SCORM) or cmi5.xml (cmi5) at its root; it is checked before it is stored and unpacked shortly after.

data.name: Std.SandboxNote
data.value: Packages run in a sandboxed frame that cannot reach Resgrid pages or sign-ins; they only report progress for the launch they belong to.

data.name: Std.PackageUploaded
data.value: Package uploaded. It will be ready once it is unpacked.

data.name: Std.KeyRotated
data.value: A new signing key is active. The previous key stays published for a week.

data.name: Std.ToolsIntro
data.value: Third-party courses (LTI 1.3) that open from a lesson and report the score back.

data.name: Std.RotateKeyHelp
data.value: Launches are signed with the department key (RS256). After rotating, tools reading the key set pick up the new key; the old one stays published for a week.

data.name: Std.PlatformIntro
data.value: Give these to the provider when registering Resgrid with their tool, together with the tool’s client ID and deployment ID.

data.name: Std.ToolIntro
data.value: The provider’s endpoints and keys. Launches share only a pseudonymous member ID unless you switch on name or e-mail below.

data.name: Std.Field.RedirectUrisHelp
data.value: One per line (https). Launches are only ever posted to these; the launch URL is used when empty.

data.name: Std.Field.PublicJwks
data.value: Tool public keys (JWKS), instead of a URL

data.name: Std.Field.PublicJwksHelp
data.value: Paste the tool’s key set if it has no key set URL. Used to verify the tool’s requests for score passback.

data.name: Std.Field.CustomHelp
data.value: One key=value per line, sent with every launch.

data.name: Std.Field.Passback
data.value: The tool reports the score back (Assignment and Grade Services)

data.name: Std.Field.PassbackHelp
data.value: With score passback the lesson completes when the tool reports it finished and graded at or above the lesson’s pass mark; without it, opening the tool completes the lesson.

data.name: Std.XapiIntro
data.value: Send course and lesson results to your Learning Record Store.

data.name: Std.Field.XapiEnabled
data.value: Send xAPI statements to the LRS

data.name: Std.Field.ShareEmailInActor
data.value: Identify members by e-mail address (otherwise a pseudonymous department account)

data.name: Std.XapiHelp
data.value: Statements (attempted, completed, passed, failed) are queued when they happen and sent in batches, with retries when the LRS is unavailable. The secret is stored encrypted.

data.name: Std.Lesson.LtiHelp
data.value: The member opens the tool in a new window. With score passback the lesson completes at the pass mark (0 = when the tool reports it finished); otherwise when the tool is opened.

data.name: Std.Lesson.NoTools
data.value: Register an LTI tool first (Trainings → Standards → LTI tools).

data.name: Std.Lesson.PackageHelp
data.value: The lesson completes when the package reports it (SCORM status or the cmi5 moveOn rule); the member cannot mark it complete.

data.name: Std.Lesson.NoPackages
data.value: Upload a package first (Trainings → Standards → Content packages).

data.name: Std.Player.LtiIntro
data.value: This lesson is provided by {0} and opens in a new window.

data.name: Std.Player.LtiScoreHelp
data.value: Your result comes back from the provider when you finish; refresh this page to see it.

data.name: Std.Player.LtiOpenHelp
data.value: Opening the course completes this lesson.

data.name: Std.Player.Sandboxed
data.value: The course runs in a protected frame and reports only its own progress.

data.name: Std.Error.NotAuthorized
data.value: You do not have permission to do this.

data.name: Std.Error.AddonRequired
data.value: This needs an active LMS add-on.

data.name: Std.Error.LapseWindowEnded
data.value: The LMS add-on lapsed and this course can no longer be taken.

data.name: Std.Error.NotEntitled
data.value: This content is not available to your department.

data.name: Std.Error.InvalidInput
data.value: Some details are missing or not valid (addresses must be https).

data.name: Std.Error.MediaUnavailable
data.value: This content cannot be opened right now (the package is not ready or the tool is not active).

data.name: Std.Error.UnsupportedFile
data.value: This file is not a package that can be played.

data.name: Std.Error.RequirementNotMet
data.value: This lesson completes when its content reports it.

data.name: Std.Error.CodeExpired
data.value: This launch has expired. Open the lesson again.

data.name: Std.PackageError.TooLarge
data.value: The package is larger than allowed.

data.name: Std.PackageError.NotZip
data.value: The file is not a zip archive.

data.name: Std.PackageError.TooManyFiles
data.value: The package holds too many files.

data.name: Std.PackageError.UnsafePath
data.value: The package contains a file path that leaves the package folder, so it was refused.

data.name: Std.PackageError.UncompressedTooLarge
data.value: The package unpacks to more than allowed.

data.name: Std.PackageError.SuspiciousCompression
data.value: A file in the package compresses far beyond real content and was refused.

data.name: Std.PackageError.ManifestMissing
data.value: No imsmanifest.xml (SCORM) or cmi5.xml (cmi5) at the root of the zip.

data.name: Std.PackageError.UnsupportedStandard
data.value: This SCORM version is not supported (SCORM 1.2 and 2004 are).

data.name: Std.PackageError.NoLaunchableItem
data.value: The package has no SCO or AU to launch.

data.name: Std.PackageError.LaunchFileMissing
data.value: A SCO or AU names a file that is not in the package.

data.name: Std.PackageError.RemoteAuNotSupported
data.value: An AU is hosted elsewhere; only packaged content runs inside Resgrid.

data.name: Std.ClientReportedNote
data.value: SCORM and cmi5 results (completion, score, pass or fail) are reported by the package running in the learner's browser, so a determined learner could alter them. For courses that carry continuing-education credit, add a Resgrid assessment lesson as well.

data.name: Std.Error.NotLicensed
data.value: You need an LMS seat for this. Ask your administrator to enable LMS access for you. The Academy and your training records stay available.

data.name: Std.App.Busy
data.value: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

data.name: Std.App.LtiFramed
data.value: The course opens in a new window. Come back here when you finish.

data.name: Std.App.LtiScoreHelp
data.value: Your result comes back from the provider when you finish. The app updates when it arrives.

data.name: Std.App.Returned
data.value: You are back from the course. You can close this window and return to the app.

data.name: Std.App.Ended
data.value: This lesson cannot continue here. Close it and open the lesson again from the app.

data.name: Std.App.Offline
data.value: You are offline. This lesson needs a connection to save your progress.
